text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — PD-8812. Service: redis-prod. Symptom: maxclients approaching limit, accept-queue growing. Link: https://pagerduty.local/PD-8812
pagerduty: Page: oncall@redwood (primary). Escalation policy: DB & Cache oncall. Urgency: high.
maria: acked — i'm oncall. pulling dashboards and recent deploys.
Ashwin: on standby, can take handoff if needed.
maria: grafana -> redis-prod metrics: maxclients=9820/10000, blocked_clients ~3200, instantaneous_ops ~18k. avg latency spikes 90ms.
jeffw: pg-primary showing active_connections=492/500, waiting_locks + slow queries. could be client retry storms.
sara_ops: support reported ~12% increase in 5xx for /v1/generate across east region. tickets coming in.
maria: checking k8s jobs — saw an ad-hoc fanout job started 02:12 that targeted user-feed worker replicas. heavy cache churn around that time.
Ashwin: command i'm running: ``redis-cli -h redis-prod-01 INFO clients`` -> `connected_clients:9805\nclient_longest_output_list:3200\nblocked_clients:3189`
sara_ops: @maria any customer-impact estimate? are payment flows affected or just async features?
maria: initial slice: user-facing latency increased for features dependent on kv lookups (recommendations, session fetch). Payments look mostly OK, a few timeouts on auth validation (downstream cache).
support-bot: 17 open tickets flagged P2 referencing timeouts and degraded performance in US-EAST.
jeffw: copying pgbouncer stats: ``SHOW POOLS`` shows spike in waiters on app_traffic_pool. A bunch of clients in `idle_in_transaction` from worker job.
maria: mitigation plan: 1) throttle fanout job (scale down or pause) 2) add a quick pgbouncer quota on worker pool 3) add a small redis replica to relieve accept queue (if fast) 4) engage PD suppression for duplicate alerts.
Ashwin: quick check — can we pause the k8s job? cmd: ``kubectl scale job/fanout-job-2026 --replicas=0 -n prod``. who can run?
maria: i'm running it now. ``kubectl get job -n prod fanout-job-2026 && kubectl scale job/fanout-job-2026 --replicas=0 -n prod``
(oncall-bot): deploy bot: job fanout-job-2026 scaled to 0 replicas by maria at 02:19 UTC.
maria: paused job. monitoring redis.
Ashwin: adding pgbouncer rate limit: updating configmap `pgbouncer-worker` to set `max_client_conn = 100` for worker pool and reloading. doing reload: ``kubectl rollout restart deployment/pgbouncer -n prod``
jeffw: applied pgbouncer change, seeing immediate drop in new connections. watch active_connections.
maria: redis accept-queue decreased to ~800, blocked_clients down to 600 in 3m. latency trending down to ~25ms.
sara_ops: support update: volume of new tickets slowed, some customers reporting improvement. marking P2 -> monitoring.
support-bot: Customer-impact note: ~2300 users experienced degraded UX during spike window 02:12-02:22 UTC; no payment losses reported.
Ashwin: proposing a short-term capacity bump: spin up an additional small redis replica (cache-readonly) and reconfigure routing for non-critical traffic. Opinions?
jeffw: ok to add a replica, but need to ensure replication catch-up doesn't hammer primary. recommend `replica-standby` with `min-slaves-to-write` off for this quick relief.
maria: provisioning redis-readonly-02 now: ``terraform apply -var='env=prod' -target=module.redis.replica_quick`` — kicked off. ETA ~6 mins.
oncall-bot: pagerduty: PD-8812 acknowledged by maria at 02:20 UTC.
maria: handing off to Ashwin — my pager cleared but i'll stay reachable for context. please continue mitigation, confirm customer-impact timeline and draft post-incident notes. :wave:
Ashwin: taking over. I'll watch replication, pgbouncer, and support feed. will also check if autoscaler misfired for worker job.
Ashwin: replication added: redis-readonly-02 joined cluster at 02:26 UTC. accept-queue now 120. blocked_clients 110. latency ~15ms.
jeffw: pg connections stabilized at 455/500 after pgbouncer throttle. no new slow queries attributed to job.
sara_ops: support update: most tickets auto-closed with resolution message. currently 5 active follow-ups.
Ashwin: scheduling a temporary read-only routing rule for non-critical endpoints to use replica by setting header `x-read-priority: low` on internal gateway for stats and recs. patch applied.
maria: thanks — looks like immediate mitigation worked. action items for postmortem: - why fanout job executed during peak production window (CI/GitOps check) - rate limit defaults for worker pools - alert thresholds tuned to avoid paging on transient fanouts - runbook clarity for pausing jobs and pgbouncer quick changes.
sara_ops: I'll gather customer timelines and sample ticket excerpts for the postmortem.
oncall-bot: PD-8812 resolved by Ashwin at 02:39 UTC (no further paging).
Ashwin: final checks: redis and pg healthy, support queue drained. reopening if anything else.
maria: thanks team. leaving thread open for postmortem notes. :+1:

Notes: include raw command snippets above and screenshots in follow-up doc.
